entries.title: Change how an open task finishes
entries.body: Ask Firstmate to change an open task's delivery, merging or care, or return it to your project's settings. Details shows each current choice and where it came from. A change does not start queued work, and checks and other holds still apply before a merge.

picture.alt: The task's Details shows Delivery, Merging and Care, each marked This task, with a reminder to ask Firstmate to change them.
